comment: Utility methods for handling PSSH atoms.

methods.name: public static byte[] buildPsshAtom(UUID systemId, @Nullable byte[] data)
methods.comment:
* Builds a version 0 PSSH atom for a given system id, containing the given data.
   *
   * @param systemId The system id of the scheme.
   * @param data The scheme specific data.
   * @return The PSSH atom.

methods.name: public static byte[] buildPsshAtom(UUID systemId, @Nullable UUID[] keyIds, @Nullable byte[] data)
methods.comment:
* Builds a PSSH atom for the given system id, containing the given key ids and data.
   *
   * @param systemId The system id of the scheme.
   * @param keyIds The key ids for a version 1 PSSH atom, or null for a version 0 PSSH atom.
   * @param data The scheme specific data.
   * @return The PSSH atom.

methods.name: public static boolean isPsshAtom(byte[] data)
methods.comment:
* Returns whether the data is a valid PSSH atom.
   *
   * @param data The data to parse.
   * @return Whether the data is a valid PSSH atom.

methods.name: public static UUID parseUuid(byte[] atom)
methods.comment:
* Parses the UUID from a PSSH atom. Version 0 and 1 PSSH atoms are supported. * *

The UUID is only parsed if the data is a valid PSSH atom. * * @param atom The atom to parse. * @return The parsed UUID. Null if the input is not a valid PSSH atom, or if the PSSH atom has an * unsupported version.

methods.name: public static int parseVersion(byte[] atom)
methods.comment:
* Parses the version from a PSSH atom. Version 0 and 1 PSSH atoms are supported. * *

The version is only parsed if the data is a valid PSSH atom. * * @param atom The atom to parse. * @return The parsed version. -1 if the input is not a valid PSSH atom, or if the PSSH atom has * an unsupported version.

methods.name: public static byte[] parseSchemeSpecificData(byte[] atom, UUID uuid)
methods.comment:
* Parses the scheme specific data from a PSSH atom. Version 0 and 1 PSSH atoms are supported. * *

The scheme specific data is only parsed if the data is a valid PSSH atom matching the given * UUID, or if the data is a valid PSSH atom of any type in the case that the passed UUID is null. * * @param atom The atom to parse. * @param uuid The required UUID of the PSSH atom, or null to accept any UUID. * @return The parsed scheme specific data. Null if the input is not a valid PSSH atom, or if the * PSSH atom has an unsupported version, or if the PSSH atom does not match the passed UUID.

methods.name: private static PsshAtom parsePsshAtom(byte[] atom)
methods.comment: TODO: Support parsing of the key ids for version 1 PSSH atoms.
